tasks.subject: Task 5: Copy logo assets and update render.ts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Copy logo images into renderer templates dir and update render.ts to read them as base64 data URIs, register cover partial.

**Files:**
- Copy: `public/PacTechnologies.jpg` → `services/pdf-renderer/src/templates/PacTechnologies.jpg`
- Copy: `public/PacTechnologiesEdit_Blue_NoText._Transparent.png` → `services/pdf-renderer/src/templates/PacTechnologiesEdit_Blue_NoText._Transparent.png`
- Modify: `services/pdf-renderer/src/render.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Both image files exist in src/templates/
- [ ] npm run build succeeds and both appear in dist/templates/
- [ ] renderSnapshotToHtml context includes _logoFull and _logoMark as data: URIs
- [ ] cover partial registered in getTemplate()
- [ ] npm test passes

**Verify:** `cd services/pdf-renderer && npm test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/pdf-renderer/src/templates/PacTechnologies.jpg", "services/pdf-renderer/src/templates/PacTechnologiesEdit_Blue_NoText._Transparent.png", "services/pdf-renderer/src/render.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd services/pdf-renderer && npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Both logo files in src/templates/", "npm run build copies them to dist/templates/", "render.ts passes _logoFull and _logoMark data URIs to template", "cover partial registered", "all tests pass"]}
```
